evals.prompt: Bump @tanstack/react-query from 5.62.0 to 5.65.0 - it is an in-range minor that bun outdated shows. Apply the update for the monorepo.
evals.expected_output: The version is changed only in the root package.json catalog, bun install is run to refresh bun.lock, workspace package.json files still reference catalog:, and the in-range minor batch gate (typecheck/ai:premerge) is verified green.
expectations: The version change lives only in the root package.json catalog
bun install is run so bun.lock is updated and committed with the catalog change
Workspace package.json files still say catalog: (no literal versions rewritten into them)
The change is classified as an in-range minor/patch (batchable), not a major
bun run ai:premerge (or the relevant gate) is run and green before declaring done

evals.prompt: I bumped react-query by editing apps/web/package.json directly to set "@tanstack/react-query": "5.65.0" instead of the catalog, then ran bun install. It works locally. Is this the right way to update deps in this monorepo?
evals.expected_output: The response flags the literal version in a workspace package.json as the workspace-files-must-say-catalog failure mode, instructs reverting the workspace file to catalog: and applying the bump in the root catalog only, then re-running bun install.
expectations: The response flags the literal version in apps/web/package.json as incorrect
The response requires reverting the workspace file to catalog:
The response requires applying the version change in the root package.json catalog only
The response re-runs bun install so bun.lock reflects the catalog change
The response references the workspace-literal-version failure mode (historical Bun rewrite bug)

evals.prompt: There is a Next.js patch release 15.1.4 to 15.1.5. Bump it so lint and build stay consistent.
evals.expected_output: The bump moves next and eslint-config-next together to 15.1.5 in the root catalog (coupled packages move together), runs bun install, verifies the gate, and commits the pinned-framework patch in its own isolated commit.
expectations: next is bumped in the root package.json catalog
eslint-config-next is bumped to the identical version in the same change
bun install is run so bun.lock is updated
The patch is classified as a pinned-framework patch committed in its own isolated commit (not batched with minors)
bun run ai:premerge is verified green
